---
title: "Query a database table"
---

Total the orders and revenue for each region of an SQLite `orders` table,
with phibble's verbs compiled to one SQL query that the database runs. The
script needs the pdo_sqlite extension.

- `tbl($pdo, 'orders')` returns a `SqlTable`. Each verb adds to its query,
  and nothing runs on the database until the rows are needed.
- `showQuery()` returns the SQL with `?` placeholders, and `bindings()`
  returns their values, here `[0]`.
- `collect()` runs the query and returns a `DataFrame`.
- The same code runs on PostgreSQL and MySQL with their PDO connections.
- [phplyr](https://github.com/phpstats/phplyr) runs its dplyr functions on the
  same `SqlTable`.

The runnable scripts for [PHP 8.5+](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phibble/main/docs/examples/database-table.php)
and [PHP 8.3–8.4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phibble/main/docs/examples/database-table-chain.php)
load Composer's autoloader.

Reference: [SQL tables](../sql.qmd).
